# =============================================================================
# SOP TEMPLATE -- Copy this file to create a new SOP
# =============================================================================
# Instructions:
#   1. Copy this file to sops/SOP-XXX-short-name.qmd
#   2. Fill in the YAML header below
#   3. Replace the placeholder content in each section
#   4. Delete any sections that do not apply
#   5. Commit to a new branch and open a Pull Request for review
#
# Naming convention: SOP-[number]-[short-description].qmd
#   Examples: SOP-012-rotary-evaporator.qmd
#             SOP-053-compressed-gas-cylinders.qmd
# =============================================================================

title: "Title of Procedure"
sop-number: "SOP-XXX"
author:
  - name: "Your Name"
    affiliation: "Department, University"
date: last-modified               # auto-updates on each render
date-format: "YYYY-MM-DD"
revision: "1.0"

# Revision history is tracked automatically by Git, but you can note
# major changes here for quick reference:
revision-history:
  - version: "1.0"
    date: "2025-01-15"
    author: "Your Name"
    changes: "Initial release"
# - version: "1.1"
#   date: "2025-06-01"
#   author: "Another Person"
#   changes: "Updated step 3 to reflect new equipment"
---

## 1. Purpose

State the objective of this SOP in one or two sentences. What does this
procedure accomplish, and why does it matter?

> Example: This procedure describes the safe operation of the laboratory
> autoclave for sterilization of media, glassware, and biohazardous waste.


## 2. Scope

Define what this SOP covers and what it does not.

- **Applies to:** [equipment, materials, or processes covered]
- **Does not apply to:** [exclusions, if any]
- **Location:** [room number, building, or area]


## 3. Responsibilities

| Role              | Responsibility                              |
|:------------------|:--------------------------------------------|
| Lab PI            | Approve SOP, ensure training compliance     |
| Trained Personnel | Follow this SOP, report deviations          |
| New Students      | Complete training before independent use    |


## 4. Safety and Hazards

::: {.callout-warning}
### Hazards

List the primary hazards associated with this procedure:

- **Physical:** [e.g., heat, pressure, sharp objects]
- **Chemical:** [e.g., corrosive reagents, toxic fumes]
- **Biological:** [e.g., BSL-2 organisms]
:::

### Required PPE

- [ ] Safety glasses / goggles
- [ ] Lab coat
- [ ] Nitrile gloves
- [ ] [Other PPE as needed]

### Emergency Procedures

In case of [spill / injury / equipment failure], refer to
[SOP-050-emergency-spill.qmd](SOP-050-emergency-spill.qmd) or call
[emergency contact / campus safety number].


## 5. Equipment and Materials

### Equipment

| Item                | Location         | Notes                    |
|:--------------------|:-----------------|:-------------------------|
| [Equipment name]    | [Room / bench]   | [Model number, if relevant] |

### Reagents and Consumables

| Item                | Catalog No.      | Storage          |
|:--------------------|:-----------------|:-----------------|
| [Reagent name]      | [Cat. no.]       | [Fridge / shelf] |


## 6. Procedure

### 6.1 Preparation

1. [First preparatory step]
2. [Second preparatory step]

### 6.2 Main Procedure

1. [Step-by-step instructions]
2. [Be specific: settings, volumes, durations]
3. [Include decision points as needed]

::: {.callout-tip}
### Tip
Include practical tips or common mistakes here. These callout boxes
render nicely in both HTML and PDF.
:::

### 6.3 Shutdown and Cleanup

1. [Post-procedure steps]
2. [Waste disposal instructions]
3. [Equipment shutdown sequence]


## 7. Quality Control and Acceptance Criteria

Describe how to verify that the procedure was performed correctly:

- [Expected result, measurement, or visual indicator]
- [Acceptable range or pass/fail criteria]
- [What to do if results are outside the acceptable range]


## 8. Waste Disposal

| Waste Type          | Container         | Disposal Method        |
|:--------------------|:------------------|:-----------------------|
| [e.g., solvent]     | [e.g., red jug]   | [EH&S pickup schedule] |


## 9. References

- [Manufacturer manual, if applicable]
- [Related SOPs: link with `[SOP-XXX](SOP-XXX-name.qmd)`]
- [Regulatory standards, if applicable]


## 10. Training Record

Training is documented in [your tracking system]. Before working
independently, personnel must:

1. Read this SOP in full
2. Observe a trained operator perform the procedure
3. Perform the procedure under supervision
4. Be signed off by the PI or designated trainer
